decision.observation: 6:10 pm, Sat. 6; the farmer holds the rod with the bobber airborne above (~0.62,0.16), line angling down—cast in flight toward the pond.
decision.hypothesis: The bobber will land in the pond below; then a dip/'HIT!' cue will come, and pressing C at it catches a fish.
decision.memory: Fishing loop: face water, hold C to cast, press C at the bobber cue; if the minigame opens, hold/release LMB to keep the green bar on the fish. Catches: Sunfish, Joja Cola ×2.
